verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਲਖ ਸੰਜਮਾ ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਲਖ ਵਰਤ ਕਰੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: lakh jap tap lakh sa(n)jamaa hom jag lakh varat kara(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Millions of recitations, disciplines, continences, burnt oblations and fasts are performed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਤੀਰਥ ਲਖ ਊਲਖਾ ਲਖ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਲਖ ਪੁਰਬ ਲਗੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: lakh teerath lakh uoolakhaa lakh pureeaa lakh purab laga(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Millions of holy journeys, charities are undertaken and millions of holy occasions are celebrated.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਲ ਦੇਹੁਰੇ ਲਖ ਪੁਜਾਰੀ ਪੂਜ ਕਰੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: dhevee dheval dhehure lakh pujaaree pooj kara(n)dhe|

en.bdb: In the abodes of goddesses, and the temples, millions of priests perform worship.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਮਹੀਅਲ ਭਰਮਦੇ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਲਖ ਫੇਰਿ ਫਿਰੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: jal thal maheeal bharamadhe karam dharam lakh fer fira(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Moving on earth and in the sky, millions practitioners of dharma-oriented activities run hither and thither.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਪਰਬਤ ਵਣਖੰਡ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਹੋਇ ਭਵੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: lakh parabat vanakha(n)dd lakh lakh udhaasee hoi bhava(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Millions of people becoming unconcerned with worldy affairs go on moving in the mountains and forests.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਗਨੀ ਅੰਗੁ ਜਲਾਇਂਦੇ ਲਖ ਹਿਮੰਚਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਗਲੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: aganee a(n)g jalai(n)dhe lakh hima(n)chal jai gala(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Millions are there who die by burning themselves and millions are there who die by freezing themselves In the snowy mountains.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਲਹੰਦੇ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit_en: gur sikhee sukh til na laha(n)dhe ||18||

en.bdb: But they all cannot take even a fraction of joy ,Attainable in the life of a Sikh of the Guru.
